components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Fluent blue action for save, send, new conversation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0078d4; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0078d4; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #106ebe; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #005a9e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005a9e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #201f1e; border: 1px solid #8a8886; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f3f2f1; border-color: #605e5c; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0078d4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; max-width: 100%; background: #faf9f8; color: #201f1e; border: 1px solid #edebe9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8886; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #d2d0ce; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0078d4; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #deecf9; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar row with left blue active bar.
components.html: InboxContatos
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 240px; background: #fff; padding: 12px 8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #201f1e; text-decoration: none; transition: background .12s, color .12s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f3f2f1; color: #106ebe; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: #deecf9; color: #005a9e; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 3px; background: #0078d4; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Status pill for tags, SLA, channels.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #faf9f8; color: #605e5c; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-success { background: #dff6dd; color: #107c10; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White stat or entity card with hover lift.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #201f1e; border: 1px solid #edebe9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 18px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1.6px 3.6px rgba(0,0,0,.13), 0 .3px .9px rgba(0,0,0,.11); font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow .15s, transform .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 6.4px 14.4px rgba(0,0,0,.13), 0 1.2px 3.6px rgba(0,0,0,.11); transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #d2d0ce; } .ds-card-val { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #8a8886; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Outgoing Bubble
components.description: Agent message in Fluent blue, sharp tail corner.
components.html: Olá! Já estou verificando seu pedido.
components.css: .ds-row-out { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-bubble-out { background: #0078d4; color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; border-bottom-right-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 65%; }

components.name: Incoming Bubble
components.description: Contact message in white with soft border.
components.html: Oi, meu pedido ainda não chegou.
components.css: .ds-row-in { display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-bubble-in { background: #fff; color: #201f1e; border: 1px solid #edebe9; border-radius: 8px; border-bottom-left-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 65%; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.09); }

narrative.overview: Atendeflow looks and behaves like a calm Microsoft 365 workbench for triage and reply. Dense three-pane inbox, flat white surfaces on warm gray app background, 1px borders, 4–8px corners, Segoe UI throughout. Blue is reserved for ownership and action — active nav, selected conversation, outgoing bubble, primary button — never as decoration. The public wiki portal is a deliberate second world: forest-green editorial knowledge base with Plus Jakarta Sans + DM Serif Display.
keyCharacteristics: Calm operational density: 14px base, tabular counts, 240px sidebar + 380px list + fluid chat
Flat-by-default with ambient lift only on overlay, hover, focus
Precise and restrained components: 4px buttons, 1px borders, 0.12-0.15s feedback
Two worlds, no mixing: Fluent blue app + widget, green serif wiki portal

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Fluent blue marks ownership or action only. If it is not clickable, selected, or sent-by-agent, it stays gray.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Segoe UI speaks in the desk; DM Serif + Jakarta speak only in the wiki portal. Never set wiki serif inside inbox, reports, or flows.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If a shadow is visible without hover, focus, drag, or overlay, remove it.

dos: Do keep blue for action and ownership — active, selected, sent, primary — on a small fraction of any inbox screen.
Do use soft + strong text pairs together (e.g. #107c10 on #dff6dd), never soft as text on white.
Do keep app corners at 4–8px and wiki cards at 12px; circles only for avatars, launcher, send, status dots.
Do show focus with a blue border + soft ring on every input, search, and composer.
Do confine DM Serif Display and Jakarta to the wiki portal; Segoe UI everywhere else.
donts: Don't introduce a new accent hue in the desk — greens belong only to wiki, SLA/semantic states, or dept color dots.
Don't use gradients outside login hero, dept banners, wiki hero, and note washes.
Don't add shadows to resting list rows, sidebar items, or table cells — lift on hover/overlay only.
Don't mix the two radius worlds — no 12–16px SaaS cards inside inbox triage.
